Overview

Velenje is a city in Velenje with a population of 25,000. A modern planned city in the Šalek Valley, built after WWII for the mining industry, known for its socialist-era architecture, the Velenje Castle, and Lake Velenje. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
